name: portfolio-monorepo
description: Portfolio site (frontend), its REST API (backend) and the admin panel that manages the content

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
